description: Processing chain of the paper: ERA5 download and TopoPyScale downscaling, Gaussian-process model and point selection, ICESat-2 observations and prior correlations, the MuSA experiments (MuSA eastriver-paper with the four experiment configurations, archived separately: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23893780), post-processing, the staging of the data record (input data, DA experiments, website data) and the interactive figure.
